episode.before: At parent 4b91ec66fd33026e6e44a0dca5a954a59abd3ee9, generated compaction summaries, split-turn prefix summaries, and branch summaries issued one model completion request. episode.after: At 65dd2e0ed6c71bd61d698353c29f2de24968bf76, all generated compaction and branch-summary model calls can use the configured bounded retry policy. A shared helper retries only errors accepted by the existing transient-error classifier, applies exponential backoff, stops at maxRetries, fails fast for deterministic errors, and converts an abort during backoff into an aborted assistant response. Session and harness adapters pass retry policy and abort signals into summarization, emit retry lifecycle events, and allow the interactive UI and external consumers to observe retry scheduling, attempt restart, and completion.
episode.diff: The merge adds reusable RetryPolicy, RetryCallbacks, abortable backoff, and retryAssistantCall in the AI utility layer; routes compaction history summaries, split-turn prefix summaries, and branch summaries through that retry boundary in both agent-harness and coding-agent implementations; supplies settings.retry from manual compaction, automatic compaction, and tree-navigation call sites; introduces typed retry lifecycle events and interactive status handling; and adds unit, harness, and issue-regression tests covering recovery, retry exhaustion, disabled policy, non-retryable errors, callback ordering, and abort during backoff.

evidence_units.claim: Pinned merge commit 65dd2e0ed6c71bd61d698353c29f2de24968bf76 has first parent 4b91ec66fd33026e6e44a0dca5a954a59abd3ee9 and states that compaction and branch summarization follow retry policy.

The AI utility layer defines a retry policy and callbacks, then implements a bounded loop that classifies retryable assistant errors, computes exponential delays, supports abortable backoff, and reports success, exhaustion, or abort.
Before the change, agent-harness compaction history summaries, split-turn prefix summaries, and branch summaries called Models.completeSimple directly without a retry policy.

Agent-harness adds completeSimpleWithRetries and routes ordinary compaction summaries, split-turn prefix summaries, and branch summaries through it while propagating retry policy, callbacks, and the operation abort signal.

Coding-agent exports completeSummarization as the common completion boundary and wraps either the configured stream function or the simple completion function with retryAssistantCall; all compaction summary variants pass retry policy and callbacks through this boundary.

Manual compaction and automatic threshold/overflow compaction obtain the configured retry settings and pass operation-specific callbacks and the existing compaction abort signal into summary generation.

Default branch summarization during tree navigation receives the configured retry settings, branch-summary retry callbacks, and the existing branch-summary abort signal; extension-provided summaries bypass model generation.

Coding-agent maps retry callbacks to typed summarization_retry_scheduled, summarization_retry_attempt_start, and summarization_retry_finished events, preserving compaction reason or branch-summary source for consumers.
Agent-harness accepts an optional retry policy, emits operation-tagged retry lifecycle events, and supplies those callbacks to generated compaction and branch-summary operations.

Retry utility tests specify immediate success, no retry for abort or quota errors, disabled-policy behavior, bounded exhaustion, recovery before exhaustion, callback ordering, and aborting a pending backoff.

Harness tests specify successful recovery of compaction and branch-summary operations, no retry for non-retryable errors, exhaustion at the configured budget, and operation-tagged retry event sequences.

The issue regression test reproduces transient mid-stream "terminated" failures and specifies that compaction succeeds after retries, fails fast for quota or disabled retry, stops after maxRetries, and can abort a long backoff.
Interactive mode displays the transient error and retry countdown, restores the branch-summary or compaction status when a retry attempt starts, and clears retry status when the loop finishes.

The committed regression oracle expects three model calls for two transient failures followed by success, one call for non-retryable or disabled cases, three calls for maxRetries=2 exhaustion, and an aborted compaction when cancellation interrupts backoff.

The implementation change is behavior-bearing rather than documentation-only: the first-parent diff changes retry utilities, both summarization implementations, session/harness call sites, event contracts, UI handling, and tests.
